data.title: 露西 · 月轨残像的夜城霓虹
data.action: 坐在落地全景飘窗前，双膝曲起环抱在胸前，多色短发被霓虹染上幻彩，指间夹着细支香烟，眼神迷离注视远方夜空中的虚拟满月，神情寂寞而深情。
data.location: 夜之城摩天豪宅高层飘窗，脚下是无边无际的赛博霓虹灯海与悬浮穿梭机
data.timeOfDay: 凌晨四点的电子霓虹深处
data.lighting: 窗外品红与青蓝色的巨幅全息霓虹广告，将冰冷反光切进室内黑暗中
data.mood: 赛博朋克的末世孤寂与属于两人的纯净浪漫
data.description: 夜之城摩天豪宅高层飘窗，脚下是无边无际的赛博霓虹灯海与悬浮穿梭机。坐在落地全景飘窗前，双膝曲起环抱在胸前，多色短发被霓虹染上幻彩，指间夹着细支香烟，眼神迷离注视远方夜空中的虚拟满月，神情寂寞而深情。 她微微抬眸轻语——“大卫……看啊，月亮就在那里。无论这个城市有多烂，至少现在……你就在我身边。”
data.promptProse: Perched atop the deep panoramic window sill of a dark Night City penthouse before dawn, Lucy wears a shimmering holographic sheer cutout monokini bodysuit catching cyan and violet reflections. Drawing her bare knees close to her chest with a slender cigarette between her fingers, she gazes wistfully toward the luminous moon hanging above endless neon towers and distant hovering traffic.
data.animaCaption: Perched on the high-rise penthouse sill in her iridescent sheer cutout monokini bodysuit, Lucy hugs her bare knees with a cigarette between her fingers and gazes wistfully toward the moon. Cyan and magenta Night City neon reflects across her pale skin and the dark glass.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a holographic iridescent sheer monokini bodysuit with bold geometric waist and back cutouts and a high-cut leg line shimmering under the neon skyline.
